standard_prerequisites.name: The projection formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Cohomology, label cohomology-lemma-projection-formula (invoked at proof line 2877)
standard_prerequisites.use: It rewrites $p_*$ of the product decomposition of $\Omega^a_{P/S}$ as a direct sum of tensor products with $\operatorname{pr}_{1,*}\operatorname{pr}_2^*\Omega^s$.

standard_prerequisites.name: The computation of the Hodge cohomology of projective space, and the section on projective space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, Section \ref{section-projective-space} (invoked at proof line 2884) and label lemma-hodge-cohomology-projective-space (invoked at proof line 2886)
standard_prerequisites.use: They show that $\operatorname{pr}_{1,*}\operatorname{pr}_2^*\Omega^s_{\mathbf{P}^{n-1}_S/S}$ vanishes except for $s = 0$, which settles part (2).

standard_prerequisites.name: The direct sum decomposition of the pushforward along the punctured line bundle and the exact sequences for its graded pieces
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, Section \ref{section-line-bundle} (invoked at proof line 2893) and labels lemma-push-omega-a (invoked at proof lines 2894 and 2900) and lemma-the-complex-for-L-star (invoked at proof line 2900)
standard_prerequisites.use: They give $\pi_*\Omega^a_{L/S} = \Omega^a_{P/S} \oplus \bigoplus_{k\geq 1}\Omega^a_{L/S,k}$ and the short exact sequences exhibiting $\Omega^a_{L/S,k}$ as an extension of twisted pieces, which is how part (3) is reduced.

standard_prerequisites.name: The product decomposition of differential forms and the twisted Hodge cohomology of projective space
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter derham.tex, label lemma-de-rham-complex-product (invoked at proof line 2913) and label lemma-twisted-hodge-cohomology-projective-space (invoked at proof line 2918)
standard_prerequisites.use: The first decomposes $\Omega^a_{P/S}$ over $P = Z \times_S \mathbf{P}^{n-1}_S$, the second kills the higher cohomology of the twisted pieces $\mathcal{O}_Z \boxtimes \Omega^j(k)$ for $k > 0$, completing part (3).

core_obligations: Part (2): use $P = Z \times_S \mathbf{P}^{n-1}_S$ to decompose $\Omega^a_{P/S}$ as a direct sum over $r + s = a$, apply the projection formula to rewrite $p_*$ of that sum, and conclude from the projective space computation that only the $s = 0$ term survives, where $\operatorname{pr}_{1,*}\mathcal{O}_P = \mathcal{O}_Z$ (proof lines 2868-2890).

Part (3): use the decomposition $\pi_*\Omega^a_{L/S} = \Omega^a_{P/S} \oplus \bigoplus_{k \geq 1}\Omega^a_{L/S,k}$ and the fact that $\pi \circ 0 = \mathrm{id}_P$ to reduce to the vanishing of the higher cohomology of $\Omega^a_{L/S,k}$ for $k > 0$; use the short exact sequences presenting $\Omega^a_{L/S,k}$ as an extension of twisted pieces and the product decomposition of $\Omega^a_{P/S}$ to reduce further to the vanishing of the higher cohomology of $\mathcal{O}_Z \boxtimes \Omega^j_{\mathbf{P}^{n-1}_S/S}(k)$ for $k > 0$ (proof lines 2892-2916).
Conclude part (3) by the twisted Hodge cohomology computation applied to $P = \mathbf{P}^{n-1}_Z$ (proof lines 2917-2920).

Part (1): dispose of the case $n = 1$ where $b$ is an isomorphism, and for $n > 1$ note that the composition of restriction maps to $L \setminus E = X \setminus Z$ is an isomorphism because $\Omega^a_{X/S}$ is finite free (small detail omitted), so failure would require a nonzero section over $L$ vanishing outside the zero section; rule this out by the local statement that on a line bundle there are no nonzero differential forms vanishing identically outside the zero section, either by local calculation or via $\Omega_{L/S,k} \subset \Omega_{L^\star/S,k}$ (proof lines 2922-2944).
proof_roadmap: Part (2) via the product decomposition and the projective space computation (proof lines 2868-2890).
Part (3) via the graded decomposition and the twisted vanishing (proof lines 2892-2920).
Part (1): the case $n = 1$, the reduction to sections vanishing outside the zero section, and its ruling out (proof lines 2922-2944).
difficulty_reason: The lemma collects three comparison isomorphisms relating the differential forms on a blowup with those on the total space of the exceptional line bundle, on the exceptional divisor and in positive cohomological degree (statement lines 2854-2865). The proof treats the three statements separately: the second by the product decomposition and the projective space computation, the third by the graded direct sum decomposition of the pushforward along the punctured line bundle together with the twisted vanishing on projective space, and the first by reducing to sections over the line bundle vanishing outside the zero section and ruling them out. The three-part reduction is the substance, so the claim is H2.
